description:
`notify` sends a message to you, the caller — delivered however you've configured notification delivery, no recipient or channel to specify.

The gateway-native `notify://user` primitive (unitysvc#1526) resolves the caller from the gateway's own auth context, then: raises an in-app UnitySVC notification, sends the category-default platform email, and — if you've set an external destination via `PUT /v1/users/me/notification-destination` — fans the message out through that destination too (any service that accepts the `msg` envelope, or an SMTP-only destination, via unitysvc#1874). Without a saved destination, delivery is just the in-app notification and platform email.

This is the HTTP-only half of the `notify`/`smtp-notify` pair (unitysvc#2063): send by POSTing the msg envelope here. `smtp-notify` covers the same delivery for callers that can only send email.
name: notify

payout_price.description: No platform commission — delivers to the caller's own configured destination

summary: POST a `msg` envelope and UnitySVC delivers it to you — in-app, by email, and through whatever external destination you've configured. No recipient or channel to specify.
